caseName: Board of Education of the Enlarged City School District v. Russman
caseNameFull: Board of Education of the Enlarged City School District of the City of Watervliet, New York v. Russman, Child With Disabilities, by Her Parents, Russman et vir.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of the Individuals With Disabilities Education Act Amendments of 1997.
